# Zoomable image (`zoomable-image`)

Pinch, wheel, pan and double-tap zoom.

Group: Media & editors. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/media';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createText` (types in `dist/web/foundations/text.d.ts`): `.mh-text--<variant>`: the type scale at the current device class.

```ts
export function createText(content: Child, options: TextOptions = {}): HTMLElement;

export interface TextOptions {
  variant?: TextVariant;
  tone?: TextTone;
  /** Element to render; default `p`, or `h1`–`h3` for display, headline and title. */
  as?: keyof HTMLElementTagNameMap;
}
```

`createZoomableImage` (types in `dist/web/media/zoomableImage.d.ts`): `mountZoomableImage` on a new `<div>`.

```ts
export function createZoomableImage(options: ZoomableImageOptions): ZoomableImageHandle;

export interface ZoomableImageOptions {
  src: string;
  /** Describes the picture; also the frame's accessible name. */
  alt: string;
  /** Largest zoom over the fitted size (default 4). */
  maxScale?: number;
  /** Zoom a double tap or double click goes to, and back (default 2.5). */
  doubleTapScale?: number;
  /** Shows a zoom control in the corner. */
  controls?: boolean;
  /** Width / height of the frame (default 4 / 3). */
  aspect?: number;
  /** Spoken how-to; the default names the keys. */
  hint?: string;
  onChange?: (view: ZoomView) => void;
}

export interface ZoomableImageHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  getView(): ZoomView;
  /** Zooms about the middle of the frame. */
  setScale(scale: number, animate?: boolean): void;
  zoomBy(factor: number, animate?: boolean): void;
  /** Back to the fitted view. */
  reset(animate?: boolean): void;
  /** Re-measures the frame (it also follows resizes by itself where ResizeObserver exists). */
  layout(): void;
  destroy(): void;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createText, createZoomableImage } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

const status = createText('100%', { variant: 'caption', tone: 'muted' });

const image = createZoomableImage({
  src: 'plans/ground-floor.png',
  alt: 'Floor plan of the ground floor',
  controls: true,
  aspect: 16 / 10,
  onChange: (view) => (status.textContent = `${Math.round(view.scale * 100)}%`),
});

document.body.append(image.el, status);
```

`ZoomableImage` (types in `dist/react/media-editors.d.ts`): Builds `mountZoomableImage` into a `<div>` it renders; same DOM and classes once mounted. Rebuilt when `src` or the setup changes.

```ts

  src: string;
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { Text, ZoomableImage } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

export function ZoomableImageExample() {
  const [scale, setScale] = useState(1);
  return (
    <>
      <ZoomableImage
        src="plans/ground-floor.png"
        alt="Floor plan of the ground floor"
        controls
        aspect={16 / 10}
        onChange={(view) => setScale(view.scale)}
      />
      <Text variant="caption" tone="muted">
        {Math.round(scale * 100)}%
      </Text>
    </>
  );
}
```
